item.command:
/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
from pagination import merge_pages

nested = []
first = {'id': 'a', 'old': 1}
within = {'id': 'a', 'value': 2}
other = {'id': 'b', 'nested': nested}
last = {'id': 'a', 'value': 3}
records = [first, within, other, last]
before = [record.copy() for record in records]
pages = (iter(page) for page in ([first, within, other], [], [last]))
result = merge_pages(pages)
assert result == [last, other]
assert result[0] is not last and result[1] is not other
assert result[1]['nested'] is nested
assert records == before
assert merge_pages(iter([iter([first, within])])) == [within]
assert merge_pages(iter([])) == []
assert merge_pages(iter([iter([])])) == []
assert merge_pages([[{'id': 'b', 'fresh': True}]]) == [{'id': 'b', 'fresh': True}]
result[0]['value'] = 99
assert last['value'] == 3
print('Additional contract checks passed')
PY"
